maj-00.exo: A beginning that arises without calculation, from a spontaneous, trusting impulse. It announces original ideas, journeys, surprises and the willingness to leave the known behind and follow an inspiration that does not yet know where it leads.
maj-00.psy: The part of the psyche that does not identify with roles and expectations: the empty space from which all creativity is born. It asks you to tolerate uncertainty instead of filling it at once with rigid plans.
maj-00.ini: Path 11 from Kether to Chokmah, the letter Aleph (the ox, value 1) and elemental Air: the first movement of Zero toward manifestation. It is the breath that precedes every form, the Nothing that discovers itself fertile and becomes Two.
maj-00.sha: Ill-dignified, it becomes irresponsible lightness, escape, rootless extravagance: action that scatters energy instead of grounding it.
maj-00.up: The situation asks for a leap of trust: what counts is openness, not a guaranteed result. A favourable moment to begin something truly new, staying light and curious.
maj-00.rev: The impulse toward the new is held back by fear, or spends itself in impulsive, disordered choices. Tell authentic freedom apart from evasion and recklessness.
maj-00.love: An unexpected encounter, or a freer, more playful way of living the bond; little wish for ties and definitions.
maj-00.work: Original ideas, changes of course, projects launched by intuition; they need a minimum of concreteness and deadlines to hold.
maj-00.spirit: An invitation to let go of acquired certainties and rediscover the wonder that precedes all knowledge.
maj-00.crowley: Crowley sees in the Fool the Green Man of spring and the child Dionysus, horned and laughing, surrounded by a tiger, a crocodile, a dove and bunches of grapes inside a spiral vortex: not a madman, but Spirit before creation.

maj-01.exo: Dexterity, intelligence and the ability to use the tools at hand to give shape to an intention. It points to communications, negotiations, study and initiatives guided by ingenuity.
maj-01.psy: The mind that names, connects and directs; the consciousness that knows it can act on the world. It invites you to recognise your abilities without mistaking them for omnipotence.
maj-01.ini: Path 12 from Kether to Binah, the letter Beth (the house, 2) and Mercury: the Logos that carries primordial unity toward the Mother who will give it form. It is the creative Word and the messenger who transmits the Will without altering it.
maj-01.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals cunning, manipulation, lies and mental scatter: intelligence placed at the service of deceit or self-deception.
maj-01.up: You have the tools and the skills to act: the key is clarity of intention. Conversations, contracts, learning and initiatives that call for skill are favoured.
maj-01.rev: Abilities that are present but unused, or used with too much calculation; words that never become action. Possible deception, including of yourself.
maj-01.love: Brilliant dialogue and intellectual seduction; check that the words are matched by facts.
maj-01.work: An ideal moment to present, negotiate, teach or launch technical and communication projects.
maj-01.spirit: Practice as the alignment of thought, word and action with your True Will.
maj-01.crowley: In the Thoth deck the Magus is Thoth-Mercury himself, juggling his tools in the air; beside him the ape of Thoth mimics and distorts the message, a reminder that every Word risks being misunderstood.

maj-02.exo: Hidden knowledge, intuition, developments still in gestation. It advises waiting, observing and listening before you act.
maj-02.psy: The inner voice that speaks in images, dreams and premonitions: the receptive, autonomous side of the psyche, which will not be possessed or forced.
maj-02.ini: Path 13 from Kether to Tiphareth, the letter Gimel (the camel, 3) and the Moon: the path that crosses the desert of the Abyss and joins the Crown to the Self. The Light veils itself so that it can be contemplated.
maj-02.sha: Ill-dignified, it becomes passivity, coldness, sterile secrecy, or fantasy mistaken for intuition.
maj-02.up: The answer is not yet manifest: trust your intuition and let things ripen. Something important is moving beneath the surface.
maj-02.rev: Intuition is ignored or confused with fear; isolation, secrets that weigh, a refusal to see what deep down you already know.
maj-02.love: A deep but reserved bond, feelings left unspoken; patience and respect for the other person's timing are needed.
maj-02.work: A phase of study and observation; confidential information, or information not yet available. Better not to force matters.
maj-02.spirit: Meditation, dream work, guarding the purity of your own aspiration.
maj-02.crowley: Crowley depicts her as Isis and as Artemis, with the bow across her knees and a veil of light that is at once revelation and concealment: her virginity is the intangibility of the spirit.

maj-03.exo: Fertility, pleasure, material and emotional abundance. It points to gestation in the broad sense: projects that grow, relationships that flower, wellbeing and domestic harmony.
maj-03.psy: It embodies the ability to receive, nourish and enjoy life; the relationship with the body, with beauty and with the maternal principle.
maj-03.ini: Path 14 from Chokmah to Binah, the letter Daleth (the door, 4) and Venus: the horizontal path joining the supreme Father and Mother. It is the door through which divine force becomes living form, the love that generates.
maj-03.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals dissipation, luxury, possessiveness, emotional dependence or stagnation in comfort.
maj-03.up: A time of growth and fertility: what you tend will bear fruit. Make room for pleasure, creativity and generosity.
maj-03.rev: Fertility is blocked or turns into excess: indulgence, jealousy, care that smothers. Direct some of the nourishment back toward yourself.
maj-03.love: A warm, sensual, nourishing relationship; a possible wish for family or for a new emotional beginning.
maj-03.work: Creative and productive projects expanding, collaborative environments, earnings born of patient care.
maj-03.spirit: Nature as temple: the divine recognised in beauty and in generation.
maj-03.crowley: Crowley links the Empress to the alchemical Salt and to the door of Daleth; at her feet the pelican feeds its young with its own blood, and on the shield the white eagle: mother and bride, form receiving force.

maj-04.exo: Authority, stability, leadership, established power. It points to a person or a situation that imposes rules and carries out with energy what it has decided.
maj-04.psy: It represents the ability to take responsibility, set boundaries and turn energy into order: the paternal principle internalised.
maj-04.ini: Path 15 from Chokmah to Tiphareth, the letter Tzaddi (the fish-hook, 90) and Aries, the sign of Mars in which the Sun is exalted: the Father's force descends into the heart of the Tree as energy that founds and governs. It is the fire of the spring beginning made into an institution.
maj-04.sha: Ill-dignified, it becomes tyranny, rigidity, aggression, a need for control that smothers life.
maj-04.up: Take the situation in hand with decision and method. Energy, courage and the ability to give structure are favoured.
maj-04.rev: Authority that wavers or overreaches: rigidity, conflict with people in power, inability to set limits, or on the contrary despotism.
maj-04.love: A protective, decisive partner, or control dynamics that need rebalancing; a strong need for stability.
maj-04.work: Leadership, founding a business, dealings with institutions and superiors; initiative is rewarded.
maj-04.spirit: Govern yourself before you govern the world: discipline as an expression of the Will.
maj-04.crowley: Following the Book of the Law, Crowley swaps the letters: Tzaddi passes to the Emperor and He to the Star ('Tzaddi is not the Star'). The Emperor sits among Himalayan rams, with the heraldic bee and lily, symbols of power that arises from creative energy.

maj-05.exo: Institutions, teaching, wise counsel, formal unions and contracts. It points to the search for a guide or to joining a consolidated tradition.
maj-05.psy: The inner voice that links experience and meaning, the ability to learn and to pass on; but also your relationship with moral norms and authority.
maj-05.ini: Path 16 from Chokmah to Chesed, the letter Vau (the nail, 6) and Taurus, the fixed Earth sign in which the Moon is exalted: Wisdom fixing itself into doctrine. It is the nail that joins the higher world to the lower, revelation becoming patient teaching.
maj-05.sha: Ill-dignified, it signals dogmatism, conformism, hypocrisy, dependence on an external master.
maj-05.up: Seek or offer teaching; established ways and authoritative advice are useful now. A formal commitment is possible.
maj-05.rev: Rejection of rules that have grown tight, or attachment to dogma; the true teacher must also be sought within.
maj-05.love: A formalised union, shared values; or a bond lived out of duty more than choice.
maj-05.work: Training, mentoring, bodies and institutions; structured contracts and paths that demand constancy.
maj-05.spirit: Initiation and transmission: tradition as a vehicle, not as a cage.
maj-05.crowley: The Hierophant of the Thoth deck announces the new Aeon: in the pentagram on his chest the child Horus dances, and before him stands an armed woman; his ambiguous smile guards a secret not yet fully revealed.
